summary.title: Gustaph (character)
summary.name: Gustaph
summary.excerpt: Gustaph is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. He shares together with his creation the title as one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Gustaph is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. He shares together with his creation the title as one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: Although he does not appear in Brave Frontier I, he is briefly mentioned in a cutscene upon clearing The Warmonger.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier II
sections.content: Gustaph made his first appearance in Rin's Chapter 1 as a major antagonist together with his creation Zaad. He later appears again in Chapter 9 at the extremely late part of the story.

sections.title: Chapter 3: To the Land of Sertavia
Trivia
sections.content:
- His full name is Gustaph Fabraska.
- Gustaph's birthday is mentioned to be November 22nd in a book released prior to the launch of Brave Frontier 2.
